primaryObjective: Make reported duration a defensible, typed, source-aware Analysis assessment without mutating canonical event records.
hypothesis: Explicit unit-bearing duration values can be normalized into conservative intervals and stable bins at sufficient cross-source coverage to make a previously unavailable assessment estimable.

inScope: duration normalization sidecar with original-value hashes and parse reasons
event-aligned typed duration projection loaded lazily from an immutable R2 prefix
compact duration distribution and adjusted comparison in the Time dashboard
outOfScope: authenticity, incidence, risk, or causal claims

estimators: source-era-region common-support standardized active/reference share difference
negativeControls: unknown and bin-spanning durations remain excluded from inferential bins
readinessContract.uncertaintyTreatment: Exact values and explicit closed ranges are represented separately; bounded, censored, approximate, ambiguous, and unparsed text fail closed or remain descriptive-only.
readinessContract.suppressionPolicy: Show a compact readiness result instead of a chart whenever typed coverage, common support, bin support, or stability gates fail. Never treat missing duration as zero.

releaseGates: sidecar to projection parity and deterministic hashes
statistical determinism, common support, FDR isolation, and holdout stability
no raw-count-driven inference and no duration Pattern Finder promotion in v1
Pages and R2 separation with immutable versioned R2 keys
desktop and mobile browser QA, keyboard, themes, reduced motion, exports, and zero console errors
identical frozen Pages package preview to production and tested rollback
stopConditions: fewer than 232065 rows normalize without free-text inference
fewer than two sources retain at least 1000 normalized rows
the assessment requires a second browser event model
rights or provenance cannot be resolved
performance or existing Analysis behavior regresses beyond release gates
